assertions.name: invertibility_test_is_vacuous_min_kappa_already_exceeds_one
assertions.source: min(kappa) = 1.4020251 > 1 over the 29 bound points, so acoth(kappa + c0) is real for EVERY c0 >= 0 — admissible or not. Recorded so that 'the derived c0 keeps the series invertible' is never banked as a passed test: it is a test that cannot fail.

assertions.name: bare_rms_is_monotone_in_c0_so_it_cannot_rank_kernels
assertions.source: rms(ln alpha) falls monotonically across the scan, 0.0346058 -> 0.00759733 (factor 4.555). Not evidence: as c0 grows, acoth(kappa + c0) -> 1/c0, a constant, and a constant lies on a power law trivially.

assertions.name: and_p_shrinks_in_lockstep_which_is_what_makes_it_an_artifact
assertions.source: p falls monotonically alongside it, 0.329059 -> 0.0549741. This is the falsifiable half of the artifact diagnosis: if the rms improved while p did NOT collapse toward 0, the flattening explanation would be wrong and the rms ranking might have meant something.

assertions.name: scale_free_between_model_spread_is_below_within_model_residual
assertions.source: R^2 across the whole scan spans 0.01751, against 0.0199736 of variance the best member leaves unexplained. Choosing between these kernels moves less than the residual within any one of them — the precise sense in which this observable cannot rank them. Threshold is a comparison of two measured quantities, not a chosen tolerance.

assertions.name: every_derived_c0_lands_interior_not_at_an_optimum
assertions.source: L6a4 / Borromean (3He): R^2 0.97464794, 5 of 9 scanned members fit better; knot 8_11 (3H): R^2 0.9748205, 5 of 9 scanned members fit better; figure-eight 4_1: R^2 0.97238228, 6 of 9 scanned members fit better. Could have failed: a derivation that landed at the top or bottom of the landscape would be visible to the series.

assertions.name: the_shallow_optimum_is_inadmissible_but_is_not_the_incumbent
assertions.source: the scale-free optimum is at c0 = 0.25 (R^2 0.98002642), below the O2 floor of 1 and so INADMISSIBLE, but strictly above 0 and so not the unsubtracted incumbent either. Reported as a LOCATION, not a preference: the margin over the derived value is 0.005378 in R^2 over 29 points, which discriminates nothing.

assertions.name: round_six_monotone_scatter_claim_does_not_survive_freeing_p
assertions.source: round 6 reports scatter rising monotonically in c0 (3.505% at c0 = 0 to 22.32% at c0 = 7.5) with p PINNED at 1/3. With p freed and the metric scale-free, rms/span is NOT monotone increasing: it runs 0.03388 -> 0.03168 -> 0.04073, a total factor of 1.286. Independent of, and consistent with, the degeneracy probe's correction of the same audit.

description: Bean qou-17mq. MEASURES what probe 3 argued: the zero-mean-derived c0 is invisible to the kappa(A) series. Scale-free fit quality is flat across the whole c0 scan (R^2 spread smaller than the variance the best member leaves unexplained) and the derived value sits interior. Also records that the bare-rms metric is monotone in c0 by construction (acoth(kappa+c0) -> 1/c0, a constant, as c0 grows) and therefore cannot rank kernels, and that the invertibility test kappa + c0 > 1 is vacuous here. EXPLORATORY. Nothing fitted, nothing wired, no kernel selected.
q0AnchorReason: q0 enters only through upstream data: kappa(A) is read from em-linking-mirror-series.witness.json, whose producer divides by a TYPED per-pair Coulomb unit tanh(ln q0)*B_pp = 0.2376702253 with no recorded pin (the proton-pinned mirror-pair-coulomb-sign-correction witness it cites now carries 0.2212723003), and that upstream witness is itself unstamped; the pin of the series this probe fits is therefore undetermined
scope: SCOPE (a). This construction, alone, cannot rank these kernels on this observable. It is NOT a structural exclusion of any kernel: no proved invariant is cited, and a different observable — one that sees the separation without going through the kernel — would rank them. That measurement does not exist in the corpus and is the open item on qou-17mq.
